newsitem.title: POLAND: Krakchemia clears convertible bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Krakchemia clears convertible bond issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish leather goods firm Krakchemia SA on Monday approved a 150-bond, 15-million-zloty convertible bond issue, the firm's president said.
Tytus Mysiak told shareholders that the issue, whose proceeds in part would go toward the building of a supermarket in the southern town of Tarnow, would be conducted this year.
The bonds would have a fixed 10-percent coupon and the price of series C shares for which they would be convertible would not be less than 12 zlotys, the shareholders decided.
